title: Kamailio World – First set of accepted presentations
html:
First set of accepted presentations for Kamailio World Conference has been published. Visit the Schedule page for the current draft of the agenda:

  • http://conference.kamailio.com/k01/schedule/

About 15 sessions and speakers have been added to the agenda of the two days conference. There are still other submitted proposals in the review queue, therefore keep an eye on our website for updates regarding the content of the event.

During the meetings in the last month, including Fosdem, we attracted the attention of everyone looking for deploying large real time communication services, from classic telephony replacements over IP to IMS, RCS and WebRTC.

We are more that confident at this time that Kamailio World Conference will exceed its initial targets, becoming the place to be this year in Europe for meeting the experts in scalable and innovative RTC deployments.
